scope: Independent luminance matching on captured native pixels, first complete cycle, both gears at93/148. Raw-source positions initialize anchor template only; all other measurements use rendered screenshots. Larger windows include rotation/occlusion: point motion is not automatically sliding. Correlation alone cannot prove near/far identity or heel/toe contact. Warm-material floor diagnostic cannot certify full sole geometry.
